variants.title: Stopping power against projectile charge in carbon
variants.unknown: the stopping power of ions z = 1 to 92 in carbon and the effective charge of uranium
variants.note: The medium changes S for every ion by the same factor at a given speed, so the effective charge found from the ratio to the proton is the same as in Mylar: it is a property of the ion's speed.

source.title: PDG 'Atomic and nuclear properties of materials' / ICRU Reports 37 and 49: Z/A, mean excitation energy I, density

variants.title: Stopping power against projectile charge in water
variants.unknown: the stopping power of ions z = 1 to 92 in water and the effective charge of uranium
variants.note: Water is the reference medium of radiotherapy: heavy-ion beams of carbon are used there, and their stopping power in water sets the depth of the Bragg peak.

source.title: PDG 'Atomic and nuclear properties of materials' / ICRU Reports 37 and 49: Z/A, mean excitation energy I, density
